Recorded claim:
The TB Tools patch-review reference says to count new-side lines from the raw unified diff and place inline comments on changed added lines. This keeps Phabricator anchors tied to the reviewed patch. An unchanged checkout line can explain a finding, but it is context rather than an inline anchor. This is documented review guidance, not evidence that a particular comment was posted correctly.

Provenance: c37abd1ad3eea51fce32197612dfb4b65b9ab040bc94752522090c7210353ff3. Original evidence IDs: d703c6abf035d9dd238ab13d8a19b0fa01f5bee5b729cada22aff923ccf0c67a.
